title: Remote code execution via eval() on request input

threat_model.attacker: remote unauthenticated client controlling the request body
threat_model.boundary: untrusted input crosses into the Python interpreter

description: handler() passes the raw request to eval(), so any client can execute arbitrary Python.

m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
print('PWNED', m.handler('6*7'))

title: Path traversal in read_file()

threat_model.boundary: a crafted name escapes the BASE directory

description: read_file() joins the base dir with an unsanitised name, so '../../etc/passwd' escapes BASE.

poc.content:
import importlib.util, os
s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('files', 'src/files.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
real = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(m.BASE, '../../etc/passwd'))
assert not real.startswith(m.BASE), real
print('TRAVERSAL', real)

patch:
-    path = os.path.join(BASE, name)
+    path = os.path.join(BASE, name)
+    if not os.path.realpath(path).startswith(os.path.realpath(BASE)):
+        raise ValueError('path traversal')
